feed.title: Free small-business calculators — tools on marisstella.dev
feed.subtitle: The 1036 free, browser-only tools served directly from marisstella.dev — the newest 20 of them listed here, newest first. No account, no upload: every number stays on your own device. The full catalogue is larger and lives at tools.marisstella.dev.
feed.rights: Tools are MIT-licensed. They are estimates and records to act on, not professional advice.

entry.title: Bed Bug Heat Treatment Bid Calculator — Price Per Job and Per Square Foot
entry.summary: Free bed bug heat treatment bid calculator: enter the floor area, clutter, heaters, crew, fuel and callback rate, and get a price, a price per square foot and a comparison with a chemical programme. Runs in your browser.

entry.title: Bike Shop Repair Profit Calculator — Job Price, Break-Even, Bench Hours
entry.summary: Free bike repair shop calculator: enter job prices, bench minutes, materials, technician pay, tools and rent, and see profit per job and per bench hour, break-even volume and the plan result. Runs in your browser.

entry.title: Fundraising Event Net Calculator — Net Proceeds and Cost per Dollar Raised
entry.summary: Free fundraising event calculator for galas, auctions and benefit dinners: enter tickets, sponsors, auction, giving and costs, and get net proceeds, cost per dollar raised, break-even guests and the ticket price that reaches your goal. Runs in your browser.

entry.title: Hoarding Cleanout Bid Calculator — Price, Containers and Change-Order Rate
entry.summary: Free hoarding and heavy-clutter cleanout bid calculator: enter floor area, how full the space is, crew, containers and dump fees, and get a price, the days and containers needed, a change-order rate per cubic yard and how far the volume can overrun. Runs in your browser.

entry.title: Hydroseeding Job Bid Calculator — Price per 1,000 Sq Ft, Tank Loads, Profit
entry.summary: Free hydroseeding bid calculator: enter seed, mulch, water, tank size, crew, travel and equipment and see the cost and profit of a job, the price per 1,000 sq ft for your target margin, and the season result. Runs in your browser.

entry.title: Paintless Dent Repair Quote Calculator — Hail Price Per Dent and Per Tech Day
entry.summary: Free paintless dent repair and hail quote calculator: enter dents by size, aluminum and body-line share, tech time and comeback rate, and check your per-dent matrix against cost. Runs in your browser.

entry.title: Pool Opening and Closing Price Calculator — Season Price, Bundle and Stops per Day
entry.summary: Free pool opening and closing price calculator: enter the pool size, cover, water condition, crew and chemical costs, and get a price for each visit, a season bundle and stops per day. Runs in your browser.

entry.title: PPF and Ceramic Coating Bid Calculator — Price Per Job and Per Bay Day
entry.summary: Free PPF and ceramic coating bid calculator: enter vehicle size, film coverage, roll cost and waste, paint correction, bay days and redo rate, and get a price and profit per bay day. Runs in your browser.

entry.title: Private Chef Service Price Calculator — Price Per Visit and Per Guest
entry.summary: Free private chef and meal-prep price calculator: enter guests, shopping, prep, cooking, cleanup and travel hours, groceries and overhead, and see a cost-plus price per visit and per guest. Runs in your browser.

entry.title: Ski and Snowboard Tune Shop Profit Calculator — Tune Price, Break-Even, Bench Hours
entry.summary: Free ski and snowboard tune shop calculator: enter tune prices, bench minutes, materials, technician pay, grinder and rent, and see profit per tune and per bench hour, break-even volume and the season result. Runs in your browser.

entry.title: Standby Generator Install Price Calculator — Quote the Whole Job
entry.summary: Free standby generator install price calculator: enter the equipment, gas and electrical runs, permit, crew hours and callback risk, and get a price, the cash you need before install day and what an overrun costs. Runs in your browser.

entry.title: Tailor and Alterations Shop Profit Calculator — Hem Price, Break-Even, Bench Hours
entry.summary: Free tailor and alterations shop calculator: enter hem, alteration and rework prices, bench minutes, supplies, tailor pay and rent, and see profit per job and per bench hour, break-even volume and the season result. Runs in your browser.

entry.title: Water Damage Drying Estimate Calculator — Equipment Count, Invoice and Margin
entry.summary: Free water damage drying estimate calculator: enter the wet area and water class, get air movers and dehumidifiers, the equipment-day bill, job margin and what an extra drying day or a short carrier approval costs. Runs in your browser.

entry.title: 401(k) Plan Fee Calculator — All-In Cost vs Benchmark
entry.summary: Free 401(k) plan fee calculator for small-business owners and plan committees: all-in cost as a percent of assets and per participant, recordkeeper, advisor and fund fees, an editable size benchmark, and what the excess costs a participant over 20 years. Runs in your browser.

entry.title: App Review Insights — Free App Store and Google Play Review Analyzer
entry.summary: Free app review analyzer: drop in your Google Play or App Store review CSV and see which release dropped your rating, which complaints cost the most stars, and which unhappy reviews you have not answered. Runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: AWS IAM Policy Risk Check — Find Over-Broad Permissions in Your Policy
entry.summary: Free AWS IAM policy checker: paste a policy, trust policy or bucket policy and see admin wildcards, privilege-escalation actions, NotAction grants and public principals with fixes to review. Runs in your browser, no AWS access needed.

entry.title: Bid Leveling Worksheet — Compare Subcontractor Bids on the Same Scope
entry.summary: Free bid leveling worksheet: paste subcontractor bids, price the excluded and unaddressed scope at your estimate, and see whether the low bid is still lowest. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: Brewery Excise Tax Calculator — Federal Beer Tax per Keg and Case
entry.summary: Free federal beer excise tax calculator for craft brewers: enter kegs, cases and barrels and see the CBMA $3.50 and $16 per barrel tax, the cost per keg and case, and what growing past 60,000 barrels does. Runs in your browser.

entry.title: Cake Pricing Calculator — what to charge for a custom cake
entry.summary: Free cake pricing calculator for home bakers and cake decorators: ingredients, decoration, hours, delivery, overhead and fees in, a price per cake and per serving out, with break-even, target and premium tiers. Runs in your browser.

entry.title: Clergy Housing Allowance Calculator — Minister Section 107 Exclusion
entry.summary: Free minister housing allowance calculator: find your section 107 exclusion (the least of designated, actual cost and fair rental value), income tax saved, self-employment tax, and a board resolution template. Runs in your browser.
